notes.title: Conduct DELUXE! Patch v1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hiya everyone, a few minor fixes and tweaks going out today, focused on Conduct World. This includes minor UI fixes, localization fixes, but most of all, a couple of new achievements to fully acknowledge the arrival of Conduct World! You can earn these new achievements right away!

We're really excited to see the creative uses of Conduct World. A lot of new ideas that we haven't seen before. We are very positive about the future levels to be published, as we are certain that even smarter, wilder, and funnier custom levels will show up!

notes.title: Conduct DELUXE! v1.0.4 Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, v1.0.4 is now out.

This patch contains bug fixes and feature requests from the community. Thanks to everyone who pitched in with their ideas or bug reports! ːDː

[list]
[*]OpenGL support for players without DirectX 11.
[*] Fixed inconsistencies with the Escape and Space buttons. They now always pause and unpause the game.
[*]Stations placed in the Builder no longer ignores your choice of passenger-colors to spawn.
[*]Fixed text being cut off in the Builder pause menu for certain languages.
[/list]

We would also like to thank everyone again for riding along with us on the Conduct DELUXE! Express. 

Any questions, issues, or feature requests? Please let us know! We keep a close eye on Discord, Steam Community Discussions, and on e-mail.
